mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.icon, c.sort, COALESCE(SUM(p.view_count + p.like_count * 2 + p.comment_count * 3), 0) AS hot_score, COALESCE(COUNT(p.id), 0) AS post_count FROM t_category c LEFT JOIN t_post p ON c.id = p.category_id AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.icon, c.sort ORDER BY hot_score DESC, c.sort ASC
